newsitem.title: UK: Limelight Group plans London stock listing.
newsitem.headline: Limelight Group plans London stock listing.

text.p: The Limelight Group said it planned a listing on the London Stock Exchange through a placing and intermediaries offer sponsored by N M Rothschild & Sons Ltd.
Limelight, a specialist retailer and manufacturer of fully fitted home improvement products, said that dealings in the shares are intended to start in mid-November.
It said that turnover in 1995 was some 134 million stg and operating profit was 13.5 million, up some 12 percent and 12.2 percent respectively on a pro forma basis on 1994.
Cazenove & Co will be brokers to the issue.
